gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-noto-sans-hatran: Noto Sans Hatran has a funnel-wide throat in its e. Comic Relief up top is bolder and looser, so bump the body size up a touch to hold its own.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-noto-sans-inscrip: Crisp and uncluttered, even in the tiniest counters, Noto Sans Inscriptional Pahlavi reads with a contemporary ease. Comic Relief is best at shouting with its open-sided bowls, while Noto Sans Inscriptional Pahlavi is best at quietly carrying the text.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-noto-sans-javanes: Comic Relief draws its letters with no brush-like swelling, each stroke staying put around the curves, bold and loud. Noto Sans Javanese, a plain sans, keeps its counters connected to the outside.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-noto-sans-kawi: Confident and chunky, the heading looks drawn with a fixed-width nib, every stroke the same through the bends. And Noto Sans Kawi, a plain sans with open-jawed c shapes, keeps a longer read going smoothly.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-noto-sans-linear-: Loud, loose and unshaded, with no swing from heavy to light. Noto Sans Linear A is the quiet half, a plain sans whose gaping c stays visible at any size.

Modern and smooth, Noto Sans Linear B lets the eye glide around every bend without a snag. But the pair's real strength is Comic Relief, whose soft, featureless hum across a paragraph gives it a bold, unfussy voice.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-noto-sans-manicha: Noto Sans Manichaean reads modern and clean, its e crossbars leaving open mouths in every line of text. Comic Relief frames its counters in same-width strokes and sits above it.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-noto-sans-mongoli: Loud, blunt and heavy-handed in a good way. Comic Relief carries the same visual mass in every letter part, while Noto Sans Mongolian flares its terminals outward below.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-noto-sans-new-tai: Noto Sans New Tai Lue reads neutral and modern, its round letters looking cupped rather than clenched. And Comic Relief, bent like one length of tubing, is the pair's boldest quality, making the text beneath it look gentle.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-noto-sans-nko: Noto Sans NKo reads in a modern, contemporary way, with c openings you can see straight through. Comic Relief, with stems and arches of identical thickness, feels loud beside it.
